notes.title: God's Miniature Garden Update
notes.content:
“God's Miniature Garden” has become easier to play thanks to game balance adjustments, map guides, and difficulty selection!

There are many elements to enjoy, such as conquering areas where ghosts roam, side quests, collecting collection items, and even exploring hidden areas.

Please give it a try!

notes.title: 2023/11/22 Update Ver.1.2.0
notes.content:
Update content
■Additional functions
- Implemented difficulty settings.
(You can change the difficulty level at any time while playing.)

notes.title: 2023/11/17 Update Ver.1.1.3
notes.content:
Update content
■Additional functions
- We have implemented a function that allows you to check the entire map.

Future updates planned
- Implement difficulty setting.

notes.title: 2023/11/16 Update Ver.1.1.2
notes.content:
Update content
■Game balance adjustment
- We have made some changes to the map composition as there are situations where the camera perspective becomes difficult to see in the final area.
- Increased the effects of permanent items.
- Adjusted the difficulty of random dungeons.

■Bug fixes
- Fixed a bug related to ghost respawning in random dungeons.

Future updates planned
- Implement the display of the entire map.
- Implement difficulty setting.

notes.title: 2023/11/15 Update Ver.1.1.1
notes.content:
■Additional functions
- Added navigation manual and language support.

■Game balance adjustment
- We have significantly adjusted the prices of items that can be purchased at the store.
- Adjusted the judgment range for opening and closing doors and sliding doors.
- Fear value no longer increases while hiding in a closet.
(Instead of placing an object that does not increase the fear level, we responded with a closet.)

■Bug fixes
- Fixed the issue where some text would continue to be displayed on the screen.
- Fixed the issue where screen effects would not return to normal in random dungeons.

Future updates planned
- We have confirmed an issue with ghost respawning in random dungeons, which will be fixed.
- Adjust the difficulty of random dungeons.
- There are situations where the camera viewpoint becomes difficult to see in the final area, so this will be addressed.
- Adjust the effects of permanent items.
- Implement difficulty setting.
- Implement the display of the entire map.

notes.title: 2023/11/13 Update Ver.1.1.0
notes.content:
Update content
■Additional functions
- You can now check the destination on the map while progressing through the main story and side quests.

■Game balance adjustment
- Tweaked the speed of each ghost and the distance at which they discover players.

■Bug fixes
- Fixed the issue where some text would continue to be displayed on the screen.
- Fixed the phenomenon where if you clear the strategy while the spiritual barrier (SleepParalysis) used by some ghosts is active, you will not be able to move.

■Others
- Adjusted the camera.
- Minor adjustments were made to some objects.

Future updates planned
- We have confirmed an issue with ghost respawning in random dungeons, which will be fixed.
- We will continue to adjust the game balance.
- Implement difficulty setting.
- We will place an object within the capture area that will not increase the fear level.
(Due to game balance adjustments (mainly reducing the rate of increase in fear level), objects that do not increase fear level will be placed instead of restoring fear level.)

notes.title: 2023/11/11 Update Ver.1.0.2
notes.content:
Update content
- Adjusted to reduce the rate at which the fear level increases when being spotted by a ghost.
- The effectiveness of mental pills (fear level recovery item) has been increased.
- The cooldown speed after using Spirit Vision has been increased.
- Reduced the time it takes for each ghost to lose sight of the player.
- Shortened the distance at which each ghost discovers the player.
- Adjusted the movement speed of each ghost to be slower.
- Adjusted to reduce the frequency that each ghost uses psychic abilities.
- Adjusted to reduce the effect time of the spiritual obstacles (seals) used by some ghosts.
- Adjusted to reduce the effect time of the spiritual obstacles (evil eye) used by some ghosts.
- Adjusted to reduce the effect time of the spiritual obstacles (darkness) used by some ghosts.
- Adjusted to reduce the effect time of the spiritual obstacles (SleepParalysis) used by some ghosts.
- Corrected the wording in the story progression of Chapter 3.
- Fixed typos.
- Minor adjustments were made to some objects.

Future updates planned
- We will continue to adjust the game balance.
- Implement difficulty setting.
- We will make improvements so that you can check the destination on the map during the main story and side quest progress.
- Objects will be placed that will gradually restore the fear level while conquering the area.

notes.title: 2023/11/10 Update Ver.1.0.1
notes.content:
Update content
- Modified so that you can explore the map immediately after starting the game.
- Adjusted the movement speed of each ghost to be slower.
- Adjusted to reduce the frequency of each ghost's use of spiritual abilities.
- Adjusted to slow down the rate of increase in fear level.

We will continue to adjust the game balance from time to time.
